relations.intro: Who is tied to whom, and how: each relationship holds across the story.

maps.nodes: empty | {n} on the map | {n} on the map

empty.title: A map shows who is tied to whom: create a map, add two characters and link them.
empty.body: Each map is one view of the same relationships: one for the family, one for the village, one for whoever keeps a secret.
empty.bodyGame: Each map is one view of the same relationships: one for the factions, one for the player's party, one for the traitors.

list.rowMenu: Actions for the relationship between {from} and {to}

empty.title: Relationships say who is tied to whom: a father and a daughter, two rivals, a character and the house they live in.
empty.titleGame: Relationships say who is tied to whom: a mentor and an apprentice, two rivals, a character and the faction they fight for.
empty.body: Each relationship exists once: you find it on both sheets and on every map that holds them.

form.missing: This relationship is gone: it may be in the trash.
form.pickBoth: Choose the two sides of the relationship: a character, a location, an object or a group.
form.pickBothGame: Choose the two sides of the relationship: a character, a location, an item or a faction.
form.tooFew: A relationship joins two sides: first create at least two characters, locations, objects or groups.
form.tooFewGame: A relationship joins two sides: first create at least two characters, locations, items or factions.
form.labels: What they are to each other
form.labelsHelp: If you leave them empty, maps and sheets show the kind of relationship.
form.kindHelp: Choose what kind of relationship it is.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: How it began, what tests it, how it changes over the story.
form.deleteConfirm: The relationship will disappear from every map and sheet. It stays in the trash if you change your mind.
form.draftRestored: This is the draft you had not saved.
form.draftKeptBody: What you wrote stays in the draft: reopen it to carry on.

empty.character: No relationships: link this character to someone.
empty.group: No relationships: link this group to its allies, its rivals, the places it holds.
empty.groupGame: No relationships: link this faction to its allies, its rivals, the places it controls.
empty.location: No relationships: link this location to whoever lives in it or visits it.
empty.object: No relationships: link this object to whoever owns it.
empty.objectGame: No relationships: link this item to whoever owns it or is looking for it.

picker.search: Search for a character, a location, an object...
picker.searchGame: Search for a character, a location, an item...
picker.allOnMap: They are all on the map already.
picker.nothing: There is nobody to add yet: first create a character, a location, an object or a group.
picker.nothingGame: There is nobody to add yet: first create a character, a location, an item or a faction.

map.knob: Drag to another one to link them
map.legendEmpty: Nothing on this map is linked yet.
map.nodeRelations: no relationships on the map | {n} relationship on the map | {n} relationships on the map
map.outside: {n} relationship off the map | {n} relationships off the map
map.removed: {name} is no longer on the map
map.notFound: This map is gone: it may be in the trash.

empty.title: Add characters, locations, objects or groups, then drag from one to another to link them.
empty.titleGame: Add characters, locations, items or factions, then drag from one to another to link them.
empty.phone: Add characters, locations, objects or groups, then link them with “Link to...”.
empty.phoneGame: Add characters, locations, items or factions, then link them with “Link to...”.

selection.label: Selection
selection.noneHere: Not linked to anything else on this map.
selection.outside: {n} relationship off the map | {n} relationships off the map
selection.outsideAll: {n} relationship leads off the map | {n} relationships lead off the map
selection.help: Select anyone or anything on the map to link it, open its sheet or take it off the map. To create a relationship, drag from its dot onto another.
selection.helpPhone: Tap anyone, anything or a relationship to see what you can do. To link two of them use “Link to...”.
selection.keyboard: With the keyboard: Tab moves from one to the next, the arrows follow the relationships, Enter opens the relationship just followed (otherwise the actions), Shift and an arrow move it, Esc closes.
selection.keyboardPhone: Tab moves from one to the next, the arrows follow the relationships, Enter opens the relationship just followed, otherwise the actions.
